HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

2. Which statement about Modern Nationalism in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Modern Nationalism in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Modern Nationalism in Africa.
   C. Explain Modern Nationalism in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Modern Nationalism in Africa as rumours only.

3. Which statement about Introduction to History and Citizenship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Introduction to History and Citizenship.
   B. Explain Introduction to History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Introduction to History and Citizenship never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Introduction to History and Citizenship as rumours only.

4. Which statement about Elections in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Elections in Kenya.

   D. Say Elections in Kenya never happens in Kenya.

5. Which statement about Linguistic groups in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   D. Skip evidence when discussing Linguistic groups in Kenya.

6. Which statement about Public Participation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Public Participation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Public Participation.
   C. Say Public Participation never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Public Participation as rumours only.

7. Which statement about African Civilisations up to 19th Century is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat African Civilisations up to 19th Century as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing African Civilisations up to 19th Century.
   C. Say African Civilisations up to 19th Century never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain African Civilisations up to 19th Century with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. Which statement about Global Wars is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Global Wars as rumours only.
   B. Say Global Wars never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Global Wars with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Global Wars.

9. Which statement about Human Developments in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Human Developments in Africa as rumours only.
   B. Explain Human Developments in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Human Developments in Africa.

10. Which statement about Colonization of Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Colonization of Africa never happens in Kenya.

11. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Mombasa
   C. Kisumu
   D. Nakuru

12. Which statement about National integration is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat National integration as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing National integration.
   C. Explain National integration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say National integration never happens in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain African Civilisations up to 19th Century and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Colonization of Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Modern Nationalism in Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Global Wars and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
